messages:
Alex: quick sync — I'm starting a small dashboard pilot for continuous-batching heuristics. goal: correlate batch formation + queue policy changes with token/sec and kv-cache behavior so we can tune token-budget targets. want low-noise metrics we can iterate on.
Maria: love it. can you list the panels you're thinking? i'll mock a layout in Grafana. :white_check_mark:
Alex: panels: 1) batch_utilization_pct (per-model, per-kernel) 2) avg_queue_depth and queue_depth_p95 3) tokens_emitted_per_sec (served) 4) kv_cache_hit_rate and kv_cache_hitrate_by_prefix_len 5) kernel_choice_breakdown (counts by kernel name) 6) microbatch_latency_p50/p95 7) pending_token_budget_by_priority 8) backlog_by_route/model
Devon: add a heatmap for incoming seq_len distribution — helps kernel selector. also a small table for model version vs avg_batch_size.
Sandeep: for alerts we should consider: batch_utilization_pct < 30% sustained 10m (signals underfilling), queue_depth > 200 for 5m (backpressure), tokens_emitted_per_sec drop > 40% vs rolling 1h (regression).
Lina: tagging: include route_id, model, kernel, priority, region. make sure we keep cardinality controlled: route_id as prefix-only and kernel as a set.
Alex: agreed. plan to sample high-cardinality labels at 5% for dashboarding and keep counters for aggregate rollups at 100%.
Maria: example PromQLs would help the mock. i can start with these:
```
# avg batch utilization per model (5m)
avg(rate(batch_utilized_tokens[5m]) / rate(batch_capacity_tokens[5m]) * 100) by (model)

# queue depth p95 by route (10m)
quantile_over_time(0.95, rate(queue_depth[10m])) by (route_id)

# kv cache hit rate (1h)
sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[1h])) by (model) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[1h])) by (model)
```
Devon: also capture microbatch formation latency histogram. small hist helps detect kernel-induced jitter.
Alex: note on instrumentation: please emit kernel_choice as an enum counter (kernel_{name}_chosen_total) and a sample label on the batch event. we can compute kernel selection fraction.
Sandeep: perf-regression workflow: when tokens_emitted_per_sec drops, correlate with kernel_choice + kv_cache_hit_rate + avg_queue_depth. we should wire a dashboard that pre-populates these panels side-by-side for triage.
Lina: retention/grades: raw per-batch traces keep 72h, rollup hourly for 30d. sampling for traces at 1% by default, bump to 10% for canary lines.
Maria: UI layout suggestion: top row real-time KPIs (tokens/sec, avg batch size, kv hit rate), middle row time-series + heatmap (util, queue, seq_len heatmap), bottom row tables (recent regressions, kernel churn).
Alex: ops-bot, can you create a metric ticket with labels eng-runtime, telemetry, batching and assign to me + maria? :ticket:
ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-4217 — "Batchflow insights dashboard + token budget telemetry" assigned to Alex, Maria. Priority: P2.
Devon: for sampling overhead — let's cap extra metrics at 10% CPU per serving process; if telemetry causes >10% CPU, fall back to lighter counters only.
Sandeep: we should add a small synthetic probe that emits controlled short requests to verify kernel selection in prod every 5m, tag with "probe:true". that helps detect silent regressions.
Alex: action items: Maria will sketch dashboard by EOD Wed; Devon will add kernel_choice counters & seq_len histogram; Sandeep will propose alert thresholds and probe; Lina will add sampling policy and retention. I'll wire up a triage dashboard snippet for on-call.
Lina: noted. will add sampling config to infra repo and link in ticket.
Maria: starting mock now — will post a screenshot in this thread when ready. :camera_flash:
Alex: perfect. thanks all — want to sync 15m tomorrow after mock for final tweaks.
Maria: sounds good.
Devon: ack.
Sandeep: ack.
